text:
Benchmarks rose over 1.6% on Monday as energy stocks rallied and Reliance Industries jumped after its quarterly results.

• Sensex closed at 75,692.78, up 1,233.25 points (1.66%); Nifty 50 closed at 23,440.80, up 387.70 points (1.68%), per Liquide and IIFL closing reports.
• Reliance Industries rose 11.60% to Rs 1,300 after its quarterly results, per DSIJ and IIFL; Nifty Energy gained 3.92%.
• Broader markets rose less than benchmarks: Nifty Midcap 100 +1.19% and Nifty Smallcap 100 +0.71%, per Kotak Neo and DSIJ.
• Sectors were mixed: Nifty Metal +3.21%, Nifty Auto +1.33%, Nifty IT -0.50%, Nifty Pharma -0.07%.

Our view: when one heavyweight stock accounts for a large share of the index move, the headline gain can overstate how broad the rally was. The gap between benchmark and midcap/smallcap returns is consistent with that, though one session is a thin sample. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: when a single large constituent drives an index day, how do you explain the difference between index return and a diversified portfolio's return to clients?
